info.title: Psychic Princess
info.synopsis: Qian Yunxi, la figlia maggiore del primo ministro, è nata con un’abilità speciale. Per questo motivo fu considerata “anormale” e fu cresciuta sul monte Lin Yun. All’età di 16 anni, ha preso il posto di sua sorella minore per sposarsi nella famiglia reale di Ye. Le voci dicono che Ye Youming è strano, freddo e crudele. Come si svilupperà il destino di Qian Yunxi?

episodes.title: Do You Think You Are Worthy of Being My Princess?

tvdb.title: Do You Think You Are Worthy of Being My Princess?
tvdb.synopsis: Yunxi Qian is torn from her mountain to marry the Prince of Ye to replace her sister Yunshang. However, she is far from an ordinary princess...

tvdb.title: Follow Me, I Run Away From You, Run Away From Me, I Follow You!
tvdb.synopsis: Yunxi tries by all means to get rid of Prince Ye who has become way too clingy. The princely couple are attacked by a demon, who seems to know a lot about Youming Ye...

episodes.title: Love in the Air

tvdb.title: Love in the Air
tvdb.synopsis: Seriously injured after the fight, the prince enters a period of convalescence, during which he strengthens his bonds with Yunxi. It seems he can now see the spirits! Dame Chu, jealous of the situation, seems to have an idea in mind to take revenge on the princess...

tvdb.title: Exorcism and Married Life
tvdb.synopsis: Lady Chu takes advantage of the prince's absence to bring the Taoist priest Meihai to the pavilion of serenity, in order to exorcise the demons. Yunxi protects her friends, and the prince his wife when the latter is about to be kidnapped by Meihai.
